Definition: from G3941; foreign residence:--sojourning, X as strangers.
BiblicalUsage: Paroikia is sojourning, a foreign residence, the time spent as a stranger. Israel sojourns in Egypt in Acts 13:17, and Peter tells believers in 1 Peter 1:17 to pass the time of their sojourning here in fear, calling on the Father who judges without respect of persons.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sojourning is the whole of this life, and fear of the Father is not terror but the reverence of a guest who knows whose house he is in.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
